items.title: Fire License
items.description: Valid fire safety license for the manufacturing premises, confirming compliance with fire-safety norms at the factory.

items.title: GST RC Certificate
items.description: Registration certificate under the Goods and Services Tax Act, confirming GST registration for lawful trade and invoicing.

items.title: Trade License
items.description: Municipal trade license authorising JB Powercon to operate its manufacturing and trading business at the registered premises.

items.title: UDYAM Registration
items.description: UDYAM registration certificate recognising JB Powercon as a registered Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (MSME).

items.title: Factory License
items.description: License granted under the Factories Act, permitting operation of the manufacturing unit in compliance with statutory safety and labour norms.

items.title: BIS 398 (Part 2)
items.description: Bureau of Indian Standards license for ACSR conductors manufactured to IS 398 (Part 2), the national standard for aluminium conductor steel-reinforced conductors.

items.title: BIS 14255:1995
items.description: Bureau of Indian Standards license for LT aerial bunched cables manufactured to IS 14255:1995, covering insulated aerial bunched cables up to 1100V.

items.title: BIS 7098 (Part 1)
items.description: Bureau of Indian Standards license for XLPE-insulated, PVC-sheathed cables manufactured to IS 7098 (Part 1), for voltages up to and including 1100V.

items.title: Pollution Certificate
items.description: Consent/clearance certificate issued by the State Pollution Control Board, confirming the factory's compliance with environmental regulations.
